name: SlackChannelConfig
description:
SlackChannelConfig is a Slack channel's settings.

 With the shared Stigmer Slack app there is nothing to declare before
 installing: the workspace identity, bot user and granted scopes are
 observed during the OAuth install and recorded in status.

fields.name: AppRef
fields.description:
The ChannelApp this channel installs through.

 Absent means the platform's shared Stigmer app, the zero-setup
 default. Set it to install through your own Slack app instead: the bot
 carries the app's name and icon, and each app is its own bot identity,
 so several agents can serve one workspace.
